営業活動によるキャッシュ・フローは223百万円の収入（前年同期は468百万円の支出）となりました。これは主
 に、税引前中間純利益409百万円の計上、法人税等の支払額202百万円を支出したこと等によるものであります。

投資活動によるキャッシュ・フローは111百万円の支出（前年同期は101百万円の支出）となりました。これは主
 に、有形固定資産の取得による支出100百万円等によるものであります。

visual_table_review.method: pdftoppm -f 8 -singlefile -scale-to 1800 -png; visually inspected current/prior columns, unit and triangle signs

method_context.scope: Reported-data collection for later reinvestment review only; no new author formula or model adopted.

limitations: All four values are Japanese-GAAP non-consolidated interim reported rows for2026-03-01..08-31; prior-year interim is a separate column.

The receivables row includes contract assets. Its CF adjustment sign convention differs from a balance-sheet asset delta; positive154 is not asset balance increase+154. No balance-sheet reconciliation or sign-reversed asset delta is computed.
The PPE amount remains negative as the signed cash outflow in the CF table. No cashflow-to-positive-CAPEX conversion or maintenance/growth split is made.
Depreciation is an operating-CF adjustment, not a cash receipt. Composition and future persistence are not verified.
The operating CF includes the reported interest/tax/reconciliation scope; it is not automatically unlevered FCFF.
No total working capital, net reinvestment, normalized reinvestment, CFO minus CAPEX, future CF or valuation is calculated.
Dashes in unselected rows are not normalized into zero. Displayed million-yen precision is not single-yen underlying precision.
